t.E132.agn: In 2014 EFSA set the ADI at 5 mg/kg body weight and found no genotoxicity concern; this limit applies to the substance produced at the purity used in the studies (93%).
t.E132.body: Indigotine is poorly absorbed from the gut.
t.E132.prod: Produced chemically by the sulphonation of indigo.
t.E132.regx.0: ADI 5 mg/kg; below the limit at the reported uses.
t.E132.summary: A synthetic, blue dye (the synthetic form of indigo blue). It is used in confectionery, drinks and desserts.
